يعتصموا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَصِمُوا (yaʕtaṣimū) /jaʕ.ta.sˤi.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# يُعْتَصَمُوا (yuʕtaṣamū) /juʕ.ta.sˤa.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
